content.text: I've reviewed the term/termination, fees, and liability provisions.

input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee amount is payable by AP anywhere in the Agreement. Section 5 is a pure revenue-share (Kubient collects from Advertisers and remits AP's share, with AP owing only applicable transaction taxes), so there are no committed subscription fees that could be accelerated. The only termination-related payment language (Section 4(a)) entitles Kubient to fees actually "generated during the termination period" — i.e., its share of revenue genuinely earned during the 90-day notice period — which is compensation for value received, not a fixed sum payable by AP as liquidated damages or a penalty. Section 7(a) also bars punitive damages against either Party. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is required.
